title_en: Fish Audio Releases Live 3, a Full-Duplex Voice Model That Reacts in 186 ms
title_zh: Fish Audio 发布 Live 3 全双工语音模型，反应时间低至 186 毫秒
summary_en: Fish Audio released Live 3, a full-duplex voice model for real-time voice agents that listens while speaking, enabling natural turn-taking without breaking calls. It moves conversational timing from hand-tuned pipeline rules into the speech model, trained on real human conversations to learn when to acknowledge, wait, respond, or stop. The model can decide to respond in as little as 186 ms for short reactions like 'mm-hmm', though full answer latency is not disclosed. Live 3 is available on the Fish Agent Platform, Fish Audio API, and on-premises, priced at $0.035 per minute (promotional until Dec 31, 2026, then $0.07), with English-only support and no published benchmark scores.
summary_zh: Fish Audio 发布了 Live 3 全双工语音模型，专为实时语音代理设计，可在说话的同时保持聆听，实现自然的对话轮次切换。该模型将对话时序从手工调优的流水线规则转移到语音模型中，基于真实人类对话训练，学习何时确认、等待、回应或停止。对于“嗯哼”等简短反应，模型可在低至 186 毫秒内决定回应，但完整回复的延迟未公开。Live 3 已在 Fish Agent Platform、Fish Audio API 及企业本地部署中提供，促销价为每分钟 0.035 美元（至 2026 年 12 月 31 日，之后为 0.07 美元），目前仅支持英语，且未发布基准测试分数。
content_en:
Fish Audio has released Live 3, a full-duplex voice model built for real-time voice agents. The Fish Audio Live 3 full-duplex voice model keeps listening while it speaks. That lets a caller pause, say “mm-hmm,” or change their mind without breaking the call. For developers, the pitch is simple. Turn-taking moves out of hand-tuned pipeline rules and into the speech model.

## **TL;DR**

- **Product:** A full-duplex voice model built for real-time voice agents
- **Runs on:** Hosted Fish Agent Platform and Fish Audio API; on-premises for enterprises.
- **Performance:** Fish Audio shows behavior demos, but publishes no benchmark scores.
- **Best:** Can decide to respond in as little as **186 ms** for short reactions like “mm-hmm.”

## **What is Fish Audio Live 3?**

Live 3 is a full-duplex voice model from Fish Audio that listens and speaks at the same time.

The core argument is that speed and timing are different problems. An agent can reply fast and still speak at the wrong moment. A pause after “What time do you open?” usually ends a turn. A pause in the middle of a phone number does not.

## **How does Live 3 handle turn-taking?**

Most voice agents split recognition, reasoning, speech generation and turn-taking across separate pipeline stages. Fish Audio team states that Live 3 moves conversational timing into the speech model. It was trained on real human conversations to learn when to acknowledge, wait, respond or stop.

They framed the old approach as piling on “more rules and more thresholds.” Fish Audio instead wants the model to learn timing from data. A separate reasoning layer still holds the agent’s instructions and tools.

**The Fish Audio team walks through 3 behaviors:**

- **Acknowledging without taking over.** A caller reads “415… 555… 0132.” Live 3 may say “okay, 415” between chunks, then wait.
- **Telling a backchannel from an interruption.** A caller saying “yeah” lets the agent continue. “Wait, actually, I just need Thursday” makes it stop.
- **Waiting through corrections.** For “two pizzas… no, three,” Live 3 waits instead of logging the wrong order.

## **How fast is Live 3?**

Fish Audio states Live 3 can decide to respond in as little as **186 ms**. That figure covers short reactions such as “mm-hmm,” “okay” and quick confirmations. The full answer is prepared in parallel.

This is a floor for small reactions, not time-to-first-audio for a complete reply. Fish Audio has not published a latency distribution. Third-party tracker OrcaRouter also reports no Artificial Analysis score for Live 3 as of November 11.

## **How do developers deploy Live 3?**

Live 3 is available on the Fish Agent Platform, through the Fish Audio API, and on-premises for enterprises. The Agents platform is in public beta.

Agents expose a REST surface under `/v1/agent/*`. Browser sessions run through `@fishaudio/agent-client` or `@fishaudio/agent-react`. Agents can answer phone numbers, connect over WebRTC, or sit in a website widget. The Live 3 page lists 2,000,000+ library voices, including cloned voices.

A pending docs pull request shows Live 3 enabled with `voice.engine: "live3"`. With it on, speech recognition is fixed to `fish_audio:transcribe-stream-1`. Fish Audio’s current docs say that model also classifies overlaps as interruptions or acknowledgements.

## **How much does Live 3 cost?**

The Live 3 page lists **$0.035 per minute**, down 50% from **$0.07**, until December 31, 2026. It says the plan includes Live 3. The pricing docs say the $0.07 list rate covers STT, TTS, basic LLMs, knowledge retrieval and tool calls.

Phone calls add **$0.01 per minute**. A number costs **$1.20 per month**. New accounts get a **$5** trial balance.

## **How does Live 3 compare with other full-duplex voice models?**

| Metrics | **Fish Audio Live 3** | **OpenAI GPT-Live-1** | **Eleven Realtime v1 Max** | **Gemini 3.8 Live** | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Design | Full duplex, timing learned in the speech model | Full duplex, delegates reasoning to a backend model | Cascaded, tuned end to end | Live dialogue model, runs tools in the background | 
| Languages | English only | Not disclosed | 90+ | 97 | 
| Published timing | 186 ms minimum (short reactions) | Not disclosed in post text | 0.57 s avg time to first audio | Not disclosed | 
| Turn-taking score | Not published | +30 pp Full Duplex Bench vs GPT-Realtime-2.1 (self-reported) | 94.1% Full-Duplex-Bench | Not disclosed | 
| Reasoning / agent score | Not published | #1 on Tau3 with GPT-6 Astra (medium) | 98.8% Big Bench Audio; 87.1% tool tasks | Extended Thinking: 97.7% Big Bench Audio; 68.6% τ-Voice | 
| Price | $0.035/min promo, $0.07 list (incl. STT, basic LLM, TTS) | $0.05/min voice layer + backend tokens | Session time + tokens | Not disclosed in launch post | 
| Deployment | Agent Platform, API, on-prem | API, telephony | ElevenAgents, Realtime API | Gemini API, AI Studio, Gemini Enterprise (preview) | 

*ElevenLabs scores come from Artificial Analysis, as reported by ElevenLabs. OpenAI and Google figures are self-reported.*

## **Key Takeaways**

- Live 3 is Fish Audio’s full-duplex voice model for phone and web agents.
- It learns turn-taking from real conversations instead of silence thresholds.
- Short reactions can start in as little as 186 ms.
- Agents cost $0.035 per minute until December 31, 2026, then $0.07.
- English only, with no published benchmark scores yet.

Check out the **launch post**, try it at **fish.audio/live3**, and see the **Agents docs**. Also, feel free to follow us on **Twitter** and don’t forget to join our **150k+ML SubReddit** and Subscribe to **our Newsletter**. Wait! are you on telegram? **now you can join us on telegram as well.**

content_zh:
Fish Audio 发布了 Live 3，一款专为实时语音智能体打造的全双工语音模型。Fish Audio Live 3 全双工语音模型在说话的同时持续聆听。这让通话者可以停顿、说“嗯哼”，或改变主意，而不会中断通话。对开发者而言，卖点很简单：轮次转换从手工调校的流水线规则，转移到了语音模型内部。

## **TL;DR**

- **产品：** 一款专为实时语音智能体打造的全双工语音模型
- **运行于：** 托管的 Fish Agent Platform 和 Fish Audio API；面向企业提供本地部署。
- **性能：** Fish Audio 展示了行为演示，但未公布基准分数。
- **最佳表现：** 对于“嗯哼”这类简短反应，可在低至 **186 ms** 内决定回应。

## **什么是 Fish Audio Live 3？**

Live 3 是 Fish Audio 推出的一款全双工语音模型，能够同时聆听和说话。

其核心论点是：速度和时机是两个不同的问题。智能体可以回复得很快，却仍在错误的时刻开口。在“你们几点开门？”之后的停顿通常意味着一个轮次结束。而电话号码中间的停顿则不是。

## **Live 3 如何处理轮次转换？**

大多数语音智能体将识别、推理、语音生成和轮次转换拆分到不同的流水线阶段。Fish Audio 团队表示，Live 3 将会话时机移入了语音模型。它基于真实人类对话训练，以学习何时确认、等待、回应或停止。

他们将旧方法描述为堆叠“更多规则和更多阈值”。Fish Audio 则希望让模型从数据中学习时机。独立的推理层仍然承载智能体的指令和工具。

**Fish Audio 团队演示了 3 种行为：**

- **确认而不接管。** 通话者读出“415… 555… 0132”。Live 3 可能会在片段之间说“好的，415”，然后等待。
- **区分附和与打断。** 通话者说“是的”会让智能体继续。“等等，其实我只需要周四”则会使其停止。
- **在纠正中等待。** 对于“两个披萨……不，三个”，Live 3 会等待，而不是记录错误的订单。

## **Live 3 有多快？**

Fish Audio 表示，Live 3 可在低至 **186 ms** 内决定回应。该数字涵盖“嗯哼”、“好的”和快速确认等简短反应。完整答案会并行准备。

这是小型反应的下限，而非完整回复的首个音频时间。Fish Audio 尚未公布延迟分布。第三方追踪机构 OrcaRouter 也报告称，截至 11 月 11 日，Live 3 没有 Artificial Analysis 分数。

## **开发者如何部署 Live 3？**

Live 3 可在 Fish Agent Platform、通过 Fish Audio API 以及面向企业的本地部署中使用。Agents 平台处于公开测试阶段。

Agents 在 `/v1/agent/*` 下暴露 REST 接口。浏览器会话通过 `@fishaudio/agent-client` 或 `@fishaudio/agent-react` 运行。Agents 可以接听电话号码、通过 WebRTC 连接，或嵌入网站小组件。Live 3 页面列出了 2,000,000+ 个库语音，包括克隆语音。

一个待处理的文档拉取请求显示 Live 3 已启用，配置为 `voice.engine: "live3"`。启用后，语音识别固定为 `fish_audio:transcribe-stream-1`。Fish Audio 当前的文档称，该模型还会将重叠语音分类为打断或确认。

## **Live 3 的费用是多少？**

Live 3 页面列出 **每分钟 $0.035**，较 **$0.07** 下调 50%，优惠持续至 2026 年 12 月 31 日。页面称该套餐包含 Live 3。定价文档称，$0.07 的标价涵盖 STT、TTS、基础 LLM、知识检索和工具调用。

电话通话额外收取 **每分钟 $0.01**。一个号码每月费用为 **$1.20**。新账户可获得 **$5** 试用余额。

## **Live 3 与其他全双工语音模型相比如何？**

| 指标 | **Fish Audio Live 3** | **OpenAI GPT-Live-1** | **Eleven Realtime v1 Max** | **Gemini 3.8 Live** | 
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 设计 | 全双工，时序在语音模型中学习 | 全双工，将推理委托给后端模型 | 级联式，端到端调优 | 实时对话模型，在后台运行工具 | 
| 语言 | 仅英语 | 未披露 | 90+ | 97 | 
| 公布的时序 | 最低 186 ms（短反应） | 帖子正文中未披露 | 平均首次音频时间 0.57 秒 | 未披露 | 
| 轮次转换得分 | 未公布 | 相比 GPT-Realtime-2.1 在 Full Duplex Bench 上 +30 个百分点（自报） | 94.1% Full-Duplex-Bench | 未披露 | 
| 推理 / 智能体得分 | 未公布 | 使用 GPT-6 Astra（medium）在 Tau3 上排名 #1 | 98.8% Big Bench Audio；87.1% 工具任务 | Extended Thinking：97.7% Big Bench Audio；68.6% τ-Voice | 
| 价格 | $0.035/分钟促销价，$0.07 标价（含 STT、基础 LLM、TTS） | $0.05/分钟语音层 + 后端 token | 会话时间 + token | 发布帖中未披露 | 
| 部署 | Agent Platform、API、本地部署 | API、电话 | ElevenAgents、Realtime API | Gemini API、AI Studio、Gemini Enterprise（预览） | 

*ElevenLabs 的得分来自 Artificial Analysis，由 ElevenLabs 报告。OpenAI 和 Google 的数据为自报。*

## **关键要点**

- Live 3 是 Fish Audio 面向电话和网页智能体的全双工语音模型。
- 它从真实对话中学习轮次转换，而非依赖静音阈值。
- 短反应可在低至 186 ms 内开始。
- 智能体在 2026 年 12 月 31 日前每分钟收费 $0.035，之后为 $0.07。
- 仅支持英语，且尚未公布基准得分。

查看 **发布帖**，在 **fish.audio/live3** 试用，并参阅 **Agents 文档**。另外，欢迎在 **Twitter** 上关注我们，别忘了加入我们的 **150k+ ML SubReddit** 并订阅 **我们的 Newsletter**。等等！你在 Telegram 上吗？**现在你也可以在 Telegram 上加入我们。**
